To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ability of pig oocytes to sustain granulosa cell functions is a reliable tool to select germ cells able to sustain embryo development.

1) the degree of oocytes cytoplasmic maturity is crucial in order to sustain embryo development, 2) oocyte cytoplasmic competence can be easily evaluated by using a simple and practical bioassay based on the ability of the germ cells to affect granulose cell steroidogenesis, and 3) this bioassay is able to select oocytes with the best ability to sustain embryo survival in vitro or in vitro, thus reducing the failure rates in assisted reproduction techniques

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the degree of cytoplasm maturation is not only reflected by the achievement of nuclear maturity but also by the ability to properly direct cumulus cells functions.

the use of a bioassay to evaluate cytoplasmic oocyte quality could be a useful tool to reduce failures in assisted reproductive technologies.
the bioassay described is a simple and reliable tool that can be used to evaluate the cytoplasmatic quality of oocytes in a wide range of species, including human.
